approach.headline: A headset opens the door.
approach.lede: An immersive experience matters when it helps a student understand something they can use.

heroImage.alt: Original artwork of young Black American students learning together with VR headsets in a skilled-trades classroom
caption: Meta Quest 3
Real people. Real possibilities.
AI-generated learning scene

body: Our approach starts with a learning objective. Each experience should connect a technical concept to a practical task, give students a chance to make decisions, and lead to a discussion about what they learned.

For example, an HVAC learner can study a system, identify its components, trace the airflow, and explain what each part does. An instructor then connects that understanding to supervised work with real equipment.

steps.title: Learn the concept.
steps.body: Understand how air moves through a system.

steps.title: Explore the environment.
steps.body: Locate components and follow the airflow.

steps.title: Explain the reasoning.
steps.body: Describe each component's purpose in your own words.

steps.title: Apply and demonstrate.
steps.body: Identify the same components on real equipment with an instructor.

practiceImage.alt: An instructor in welding gear showing a student a finished weld coupon in the training shop
caption: Where the learning lands.
Instructor-led review of real work

approach.note: VR prepares and reinforces. **Supervised hands-on training develops and verifies practical competence.**

items.title: Build the foundation.
items.body: Start with technical vocabulary, safety awareness, tool recognition, and the principles behind each task.

items.title: Make the connection.
items.body: Explore a virtual work environment. Follow a sequence, identify an issue, and explain your decisions.

items.title: Understand your next step.
items.body: Review the experience with an instructor, identify gaps, and set a focus for the next practice session.

items.title: Take it into the real world.
items.body: Reinforce learning through supervised shop work and practical assessment.
